title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 020
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute calendar and coin variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Blank calendar page with top binder tabs and an empty lower panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a generic calendar symbol without visible dates or numbers.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for dated calendar variants when the lower panel should stay blank.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the plainest calendar page with binder tabs and no interior date marks.

items.depicts_observation: Calendar page with top binder tabs and six small date dots
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a calendar that explicitly shows small date markers inside the page.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the blank or numbered calendar variants when the six interior dots matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds six date dots inside the calendar body while keeping the same top tabs.

items.depicts_observation: Tear off calendar block with the number ten on the front panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a tear off day block rather than a full hanging calendar page.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the hanging calendar page icons when the bold number on a block should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot changes the shape from a page to a tear off desk block with the number ten.

items.depicts_observation: Coin outline from the side with a thin oval cylinder body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the simplest single coin profile without extra stack bands.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for stacked or gem like coins when the single thin coin edge matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows one thin coin profile instead of a stack or decorative emblem.

items.depicts_observation: Stacked coin cylinder with two horizontal bands across the body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a taller stacked coin form rather than a single flat coin.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the single coin profile when the stacked cylinder bands are visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a second band to make the coin read as a short stacked cylinder.
